# Cochrane

> > Statistics that save lives: Cochrane is a global, independent network producing high-quality systematic reviews and evidence synthesis to inform healthcare decisions worldwide.

Cochrane is a non-profit organization dedicated to evidence-based medicine through rigorous systematic reviews and health research synthesis. The site provides free access to health evidence, learning resources, and opportunities for researchers and healthcare professionals to contribute to evidence generation across 11+ languages.

## Key Topics

- Cochrane Reviews
- Cochrane Library
- Systematic Reviews
- Evidence Synthesis
- Evidence-Based Medicine
- Health Guidelines
- RevMan
- Global Health
- Patient Engagement
- AI Tools
- Health Research
- Cochrane Membership
- Cochrane Crowd
- Global Collaboration
- Health Evidence

## Core Resources

- [Our evidence](https://www.cochrane.org/evidence): Searchable health evidence with plain language summaries and Cochrane Library access
- [About us](https://www.cochrane.org/about-us): Cochrane organizational overview, mission, and non-profit network information
- [Products and services](https://www.cochrane.org/products-and-services): Cochrane products including RevMan, Cochrane Library, and consultancy services
- [Our impact](https://www.cochrane.org/about-us/our-impact): Cochrane impact metrics and outcomes from 30+ years of health evidence work

## Get Involved & Community

- [Get involved](https://www.cochrane.org/get-involved): Volunteer opportunities, membership, and community contribution to Cochrane
- [Translate our evidence](https://www.cochrane.org/get-involved/translate-our-evidence): Guide to translating Cochrane evidence and volunteering in translation program

## Learning & Education

- [Learn](https://www.cochrane.org/learn): Free learning resources for health evidence, systematic reviews, and methods
- [For authors](https://www.cochrane.org/authors): Author guide for systematic review process, RevMan, and editorial standards

## Multilingual Access

- [Cochrane (English)](https://www.cochrane.org): Cochrane homepage showcasing evidence-based medicine and systematic reviews
- [Cochrane (Spanish)](https://www.cochrane.org/es): Cochrane homepage in Spanish with health evidence and global impact
- [Cochrane (French)](https://www.cochrane.org/fr): Cochrane homepage in French with evidence synthesis and global collaboration
- [Cochrane (German)](https://www.cochrane.org/de): Cochrane homepage in German featuring evidence synthesis and AI tools
- [Cochrane (Russian)](https://www.cochrane.org/ru): Cochrane homepage in Russian highlighting Cochrane Reviews and AI evaluation
- [Cochrane (Persian)](https://www.cochrane.org/fa): Cochrane homepage in Persian featuring evidence synthesis and health research
- [Cochrane (Croatian)](https://www.cochrane.org/hr): Cochrane homepage in Croatian with systematic reviews and health guidelines
- [Cochrane (Malay)](https://www.cochrane.org/ms): Cochrane homepage in Malay with evidence-based medicine and health guidelines
- [Cochrane (Thai)](https://www.cochrane.org/th): Cochrane homepage in Thai with systematic reviews and health policy focus
- [Cochrane (Traditional Chinese)](https://www.cochrane.org/zh-hant): Cochrane homepage in Traditional Chinese with Cochrane Library and reviews
- [Cochrane (Simplified Chinese)](https://www.cochrane.org/zh-hans): Cochrane homepage in Simplified Chinese featuring systematic reviews

## Account & Access

- [Cochrane Account Login](https://www.cochrane.org/cochranelogin): Login portal for Cochrane accounts and institutional access
